snippet.title: Memoirium - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Memoirium is OUT NOW on PC.
Get it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294440/Memoirium/

Descend into a realm of interconnected dreams as a Dreamer seeking truth and purpose. Defeat maniacal phantasms haunting a confluence of imaginative spaces, from abandoned schools and graveyards to otherworldly spaceships.


Wield an eclectic arsenal of weaponry ranging from traditional swords and spears to guitars and energy-based armaments. Discover stat-altering armor and lullaby incantations that mix spell-slinging into the sword-swinging. Find mementos to decorate a safe room for the Dreamer to rest and reflect before setting out to defeat the dreamscape's illusions, all rendered in a PlayStation 1-era graphical style.

Developer: GoldenGratus
X: x.com/Memoirium_game
